model: 40 quotient points are output ports; every root has equal coupling weight; roots in the quotient kernel are dark; port intensities add incoherently
physical_boundary: This is a falsifiable finite readout model, not a derivation of an optical Hamiltonian or coupling law. A hardware claim requires showing that prepared modes couple approximately equally to lattice roots and that quotient-kernel roots are experimentally dark.
theorem: Within the equal-root-coupling 40-port model, the rank-24 carriers are perfectly separated by two dimensionless measurements. E8^3 is delocalized, E6^4 is line-localized with a 1/4 dark fraction, and A2^12 is line-localized with no dark fraction.
